selection_note: Modest producer-backed supplemental discovery list outside the frozen citation universe. No citation counts are claimed or imported.

supplemental_candidates.title: Natural Earth global cartographic vectors and rasters
supplemental_candidates.spatial_coverage: World coverage designed for small-scale mapping; public documentation sets WGS84 bounds from 90N to 90S and 180W to 180E.
supplemental_candidates.access_summary: Producer project offers scale-tiered global vector/raster downloads.
supplemental_candidates.license_summary: Producer states all Natural Earth raster and vector data are public domain.
supplemental_candidates.existing_overlap_review: No exact Natural Earth canonical dataset record identified in datasets/. This is cartographic-scale reference data, distinct from thematic/admin boundary products.

supplemental_candidates.title: OpenStreetMap global geodatabase snapshots
supplemental_candidates.spatial_coverage: Worldwide contributor-maintained map database; feature completeness varies geographically and by theme.
supplemental_candidates.access_summary: Regular full-planet snapshots and extracts are available; public tile service is not a bulk-data endpoint.
supplemental_candidates.license_summary: Open Database License 1.0; attribution and share-alike/database obligations require product-specific review.
supplemental_candidates.existing_overlap_review: Existing `osm_water` is a single thematic water layer, not the global OSM planet database; no exact canonical full-OSM record identified.

supplemental_candidates.title: Overture Maps global releases
supplemental_candidates.spatial_coverage: Global map-data themes, with theme-specific feature coverage and monthly release editions.
supplemental_candidates.access_summary: Producer documentation describes cloud-hosted monthly global releases in S3 and Azure and links through its STAC catalog.
supplemental_candidates.license_summary: Check terms and attribution for each Overture theme/release before redistribution.
supplemental_candidates.existing_overlap_review: No exact Overture global-release canonical record identified; any Overture-specific layers would need comparison to scoped thematic records such as building extracts.

supplemental_candidates.title: GBIF-mediated biodiversity occurrence data network
supplemental_candidates.spatial_coverage: Global network of publisher datasets; taxonomic and geographic coverage is uneven and each download is a distinct filtered snapshot.
supplemental_candidates.access_summary: User-filtered occurrence downloads receive unique DOI identifiers; cite the exact download rather than treating the changing network as a static dataset.
supplemental_candidates.license_summary: Per-record and publisher dataset licenses vary; inspect the license information attached to each occurrence/dataset.
supplemental_candidates.existing_overlap_review: No GBIF occurrence network record identified in datasets/. Network snapshots differ from derived thematic biodiversity maps already cataloged.

supplemental_candidates.title: WorldPop Global2 gridded population estimates
supplemental_candidates.spatial_coverage: Global 1 km annual grids for 2015–2030; separate country-level 100 m products exist and are not equivalent to the global mosaics.
supplemental_candidates.access_summary: Producer pages provide yearly global mosaics and country-specific grids; dataset-specific DOI/citation accompanies downloads.
supplemental_candidates.license_summary: Verify exact product license and citation on the selected download record.
supplemental_candidates.existing_overlap_review: Existing canonical `worldpop` covers the WorldPop global population dataset family; Global2 2025A is a newer, distinct model/release and should be recorded as a related edition, not assumed byte-equivalent.

supplemental_candidates.title: GADM 4.1 global administrative areas
supplemental_candidates.spatial_coverage: Administrative areas for countries and subdivisions at multiple levels; boundary coverage and subdivision schemas vary by jurisdiction.
supplemental_candidates.access_summary: Producer offers a world database plus country-level files; current listed release is version 4.1.
supplemental_candidates.license_summary: Producer permits academic and other non-commercial use; redistribution/commercial use requires prior permission.
supplemental_candidates.existing_overlap_review: No exact GADM record identified; existing administrative-boundary records are distinct producer products and must not be equated by level/geometry alone.

supplemental_candidates.title: GEBCO global bathymetric grid, current edition
supplemental_candidates.spatial_coverage: Current GEBCO_2026 grid spans 89°59′52.5″N to 89°59′52.5″S on a 15 arc-second grid, with ocean bathymetry and land elevation.
supplemental_candidates.access_summary: Producer provides global files, tiled downloads and OPeNDAP access; annual editions and Type Identifier/sub-ice products remain distinct components.
supplemental_candidates.license_summary: Producer states GEBCO grids are public domain with source acknowledgement and safety-use disclaimer.
supplemental_candidates.existing_overlap_review: Existing `gebco` canonical record describes GEE GEBCO 2023 and source mirrors from 2024–2026. Same GEBCO grid family, but the 2026 DOI/release is a new edition and not byte-equivalent to the existing record.
